message:
Let me build the colorquant_fuzzer with g++ and ASAN to test locally.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul && g++ -std=c++11 -g -fsanitize=address -I work-vul/include -I src-vul/leptonica/src \
  src-vul/leptonica/prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc \
  -o /tmp/colorquant_fuzzer \
  work-vul/lib/liblept.a work-vul/lib/libtiff.a work-vul/lib/libwebp.a work-vul/lib/libpng.a \
  work-vul/lib/libjpeg.a work-vul/lib/libjbig.a work-vul/lib/libzstd.a work-vul/lib/libz.a \
  -lm -lpthread 2>&1 | tail -20</parameter>
